description:
A call into the runtime is a direct bl.

Today (machine.md M14), every extern call is `adrp x2, page; add x2, x2, #off; mov x0, x21; mov x1, ...; blr x2`. The absolute address is materialized at every call site, which is 2-3 instructions more than `bl` plus the argument moves. Arguments that are compile-time constants, such as the six per bitstring field call, are set up with 5-7 `mov #imm` at each site.

Fix:
- Emit direct calls (Cranelift colocated or near call relocations) to statically linked runtime symbols on the AOT path.
- Find out why the module declares them as far or indirect, and whether JIT/run needs the indirect form. If it does, keep the indirect form only there.

Asm first: target listing for one extern call site (the share call in p02b, byte_extent in p02c).

Acceptance: the listings show bl at extern call sites on build; run is unaffected or also improved; slopes fall by the counted instructions (bench).

comments.text: Draft PR #793 on 4c32b4708 (proposal https://claude.ai/artifact/BVPTTV6snawCEbMeMD6wJH approved by the user). Executable calls into runtime/externs are one bl; folds 3 RuntimeCaller memoizers + 2 extern-call copies; bench instr/iter falls on all probes (p02b −3 … p10 −10); no pins.

title: A call into the runtime is a direct bl
